Task breakdown generated. No `after_tasks` hooks are configured, so I'll present here for review — per your request, before any implementation.

## ✅ `tasks.md` ready for review

**64 tasks**, organized by your 12 user stories in priority order, each with exact file paths.

**Format validation**: every task uses the checklist format (`- [ ] Txxx [P?] [USx?] description + file path`); setup/foundational/polish carry no story label, story tasks do.

### Breakdown

| Phase | Tasks | |
|---|---|---|
| 1 · Setup | T001–T004 | project tree, npm deps (pinned), esbuild, `.harness/app.json` |
| 2 · Foundational *(blocks all)* | T005–T010 | DB schema + connection, URL util, Express wiring, API skeleton, SPA shell |
| 3 · **US1 Save w/ auto info** (P1) 🎯 | T011–T016 | metadata service, bookmark model, create/edit, dedupe→open existing |
| 4 · **US2 Browse & open** (P1) 🎯 | T017–T020 | list model, list endpoint, readable list view, empty state |
| 5 · US3 Tags (P2) | T021–T024 | tag model, suggestions, filter |
| 6 · US4 Notes/edit/delete (P2) | T025–T028 | Markdown+sanitize, delete w/ confirm |
| 7 · US5 Powerful search (P2) | T029–T033 | parser→AST→evaluator, all contract examples |
| 8 · US6 Read-later (P2) | T034–T036 | read/unread, unread view |
| 9 · US7 Archive (P2) | T037–T039 | reversible archive, archive view |
| 10 · US8 Bulk actions (P3) | T040–T042 | select many / whole view, add+remove tag |
| 11 · US9 Saved searches (P3) | T043–T046 | text + included/excluded tags |
| 12 · US10 Sorting & prefs (P3) | T047–T049 | sort, page size, text size persisted |
| 13 · US11 Saved copies (P3) | T050–T055 | self-contained HTML, PDF store, Internet Archive |
| 14 · US12 Import/export (P3) | T056–T059 | Netscape HTML, fields preserved, round-trip |
| 15 · Polish | T060–T064 | e2e fixtures, perf seed, persistence/SC checks, README, quickstart run |

### Highlights
- **MVP is US1 + US2** (T001–T020): save, see, and open bookmarks end-to-end — a demoable stopping point.
- **Tests are targeted, not full TDD** (per plan §D10): unit tests for the search parser, import/export round-trip, and metadata parsing, plus one Playwright e2e per story. External fetches (pages, Internet Archive) are stubbed with local fixtures.
- **Parallel opportunities** flagged with `[P]` and listed per story.
- **Story ordering respects real dependencies**: tags (US3) and search (US5) land before the bulk/saved-search stories that build on them.

### Note on the review environment
Some tasks fetch live pages / reach the Internet Archive. If the review container has limited outbound internet, snapshots and archive preservation may not reach real sites — the app degrades gracefully by design, tests use local fixtures, and I'll report honestly rather than fake results.

---

**Please review the task list** (`specs/001-bookmark-manager/tasks.md`). Anything to re-order, add, or cut?

Once you approve, I'll run **`speckit-implement`** to build it — starting with Setup → Foundational → the US1+US2 MVP, pausing there so you can see it working at `http://maker:4000` before I continue with the P2/P3 stories. Shall I proceed?
